3 Ingredient Strawberry Ice Cream

Brandi Doming
5 from 2 votes
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Course Dessert
Cuisine American

Ingredients

  • 16 ounces (1 pound) frozen strawberries, must be frozen
  • 2 huge tablespoons raw cashew butter
  • 1/2 cup (120g) plant-based milk (I used almond)
  • optional for more sweetness: 1 tablespoon maple syrup
  • pinch of fine sea salt

Instructions
 

  • You must use frozen strawberries because this is what creates the instant soft serve. Set the frozen strawberries out to thaw for about 20 minutes or pop in to microwave 45 seconds. This allows for easier blending so you don’t need more milk to dilute the flavor.
  • .Add all the ingredients to a powerful blender or food processor (I used a food processor) and blend until completely smooth and creamy. You’ll need to scrape down the sides a few times to get it going.You can enjoy it right away as a soft serve texture or place in the freezer to set and firm up for an hour or two.
